title: No Determination | ASL | No Code 14 Days
description:
Israel-route flight was disrupted but NO disruption code (arrival, departure, or cancellation) has been assigned after the full 14-day polling window. The flight data (times, status) may be partially available, but without a disruption code, DDS cannot determine controllability � and controllability is required for eligibility assessment. Different from ND-05 (ALL data missing) � here some data exists but the critical CODE is absent. Case routed for agent review.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger. Journey: Israel route (AC operated). Flight data: Partially available (times may exist). Disruption codes: ALL NULL � arrival code, departure code, cancellation code = MISSING after 14-day polling. 14-day retry: EXHAUSTED. Regime: ASL applicable.
